title: RAW UNREVIEWED: qor chor shor as donor introduction, resumption and donor-derived material in the complete graft account
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. The complete23-group f17r.4–6 graft draft contains qor=DONOR, chor=DONOR and shor=SHOOT_FROM_DONOR. Try a single explicit donor-reference family that derives the source plant and detached graft material while preserving the ordered stock/donor pair. The existing23 singleton meanings and seasonal/refusal limits remain; this is not new graft evidence or a global chor/shor translation.

design.mechanism: One episode-owned root or names the donor participant. q-or introduces it in the ordered pair; ch-or resumes that individual; sh-or projects material taken from that same donor for a proposed graft. Exactly these three wrappers and their type/lifetime rule are new C0 choices.
design.unit: Whole ZL f17r.4–6,23 groups, all23 once; complete IT22 and unbound original projection retained. No successor target read.
design.contrast: A shared donor-reference family versus three independent whole-word meanings, or generic SHOOT with no written source identity.
design.prediction: The donor introduced beside STOCK must be the donor resumed in the methods clause and the source of its graft material. A second nearby botanical noun cannot silently replace it. Refusal remains about the contemplated graft using those participants, not about all fruit of the stock.
design.scope: Local donor/source/material family; no named modern taxon, no rendering of every -or word and no donor identity inferred from a drawing.

additional_assumptions: The old 23 meanings remain C0. Introduced donor B, detached shoot S and bark-with-bud T are distinct; material-from is not numerical identity with the living source plant.

The root or and q/ch/sh wrappers are not independently confirmed morphemes. Three wrapper meanings plus one root/reference binder may cost as much as the three old whole meanings. No compression success is claimed.
The pair/order scope comes from the existing explicit SELECT_PAIR and FIRST grammar, itself guessed. Resumption must follow this scope rather than being indexed to C3.
The donor of cthey bark budding is already buried in the old compound whole meaning; it does not become written or-derived material automatically.
cphor=INSERT_SPLIT also ends in or and shol=STOCK begins with sh. They are concrete barriers to an unrestricted segment rule; any typed restriction is charged, not a post-test rescue.
two_discriminating_consequences: Under unchanged SELECT_PAIR(STOCK A,DONOR B), qor then chor must denote B, while shor must denote S with FROM(S,B), not A or a new source plant. The proposed family must derive this without the old per-clause donor lookups.

The later graft-specific result can inherit source provenance only through that explicit B-to-S link. A method applied to unrelated S2 does not count as the already introduced stock/donor case. The old refusal consequence itself was already proved conditionally in1021 and is not new information.
strongest_known_countercases: GDT1021 already fixed all these identities and all23 forms are singletons. This card currently has no repeated paired-family occurrence and no new empirical consequence.
IDEA526 review finds zero unchanged old23 values in the whole ZL immediate successor; do not launch or repair that continuation as the family test.

GDT768 supports parallel nominal plant-part roles but does not orient flower versus seed/fruit; global dry/moist was rejected by family ablation. GDT1080 supplies no visual direction. None validates living donor versus detached shoot.
The GDT915 transfer concerns known r/l families, with mixed cases retained; it does not make q/ch/sh grammatical cases or permit unlimited unseen-stem transfer.
All three ZL lines remain anchor-ineligible; tcho@154; unresolved. IT tcho?, qofcho and chekeg remain unbound.
